description_text:
Our client is an established Corporate Service Provider in Malta, offering a range of corporate, accounting, taxation, and business advisory services to local and international clients.
 The company is currently seeking a qualified and experienced Accountant with a valid warrant to join its team in Gozo. This is an excellent opportunity for a professional with corporate services experience who is looking to take responsibility for a diverse portfolio of clients and contribute to the delivery of high-quality accounting and financial services.
 Key Responsibilities
 Manage and oversee accounting activities for a portfolio of corporate clients.
 Prepare and review management accounts and annual financial statements.
 Oversee bookkeeping activities and ensure the accuracy of accounting records and reconciliations.
 Prepare and review VAT and tax returns, ensuring timely and accurate submissions.
 Ensure clients comply with applicable accounting standards, tax legislation, and statutory requirements.
 Liaise with clients regarding their accounting, taxation, and financial reporting requirements.
 Coordinate with external auditors and assist with the preparation of documentation required for audits.
 Monitor regulatory and statutory deadlines to ensure all submissions are completed on time.
 Provide accounting and financial guidance to clients when required.
 Assist the management team with accounting-related matters, projects, and other business activities.
 Requirements
 Only candidates currently residing in Gozo will be considered for this position. 
 A valid Accountancy Warrant (CPA or CPAA) is essential.
 A relevant degree or equivalent professional qualification in Accountancy.
 Previous experience within a Corporate Service Provider (CSP) is essential.
 Good knowledge of Maltese accounting, taxation, and VAT requirements.
 Experience preparing management accounts, financial statements, and tax and VAT returns.
 Fluency in both Maltese and English, written and spoken, is essential.
 Excellent organisational skills, accuracy, and attention to detail.
 Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to manage client relationships.
 Ability to work independently, take ownership of responsibilities, and manage multiple deadlines.
 What Our Client Offers
 The opportunity to work with a diverse portfolio of local and international clients.
 Exposure to a broad range of corporate and financial structures.
 A professional working environment within an established Corporate Service Provider.
 Opportunities for professional development and career progression.
 If you are a warrant-holding Accountant residing in Gozo, with corporate services experience, we would love to hear from you. Apply today!
